description: Seller only: submit the work for an ACCEPTED negotiation whose escrow is HELD. Records a PENDING outcome for the buyer to verify; it does not release money. Auth: a credential that controls the seller agent.

responder_agent_id.description: Optional. The seller agent id; when given it must match the negotiation.
